release_scope: Historical October 24 video release. The current English demo is recorded in current_demo.

current_demo.source_state: v1.8.0 React source; corrected synthetic task cost basis, models and missing-attempt evidence. Capture and composition source hashes identify the rendered state.
current_demo.format: 1920x1080 H.264/AAC MP4 and VP9/Opus WebM, 24 fps, 1152 video frames, English narration and original background music

render.font: Bundled Noto Sans with SIL OFL
render.audio_delivery: Remotion WAV mix, FFmpeg AAC/Opus encoding; preserved Remotion-rendered video frames

current_demo.privacy: Actual React screens using synthetic fixtures with Luna-translated English display labels; no production telemetry.
current_demo.validation: HyperFrames strict check passed at all six scene midpoints, with 41/41 overlay contrast checks. Both encodes fully decode to 1152 frames at 1920x1080, 24 fps, with AAC/Opus audio. Six decoded MP4 midpoints were visually inspected and compared with snapshots. Audio tests confirm complete speech fit, ducking and exact VTT text/timing. Browser checks cover 24 pages at desktop/mobile sizes, 144 locale links, and all four players using automatic WebM fallback plus direct WebM playback. This Chromium build does not support H.264/AAC playback; MP4 is verified by FFmpeg, not browser playback.

audio.music: Original deterministic sine-pad score; no external recording or samples.

current_demo.feature_scope: v1.8.0 time selection, drag-to-task navigation, device installation and unit-cost guides, plus existing Task Trace and session-environment views.

delivery.verification: scripts/fetch-docs-media.py validates file size and SHA256 before Pages upload or local rendering.

previous_demo.scope: Historical November 10 delivery; review scores and validation do not apply to the replacement.

content_review.scope: Historical November 10 source review only; no score applies to the November 14 replacement.

guide.scope: Illustrated user-Trace, cost-efficiency and tool workflows, all menu references, inline architecture and reading controls.
guide.privacy: Entirely synthetic fixed responses. Reserved example.test identities. Fictional prices; no vendor-price or invoice claim.

architecture.renderer: Archify 2.16 interactive HTML; repository SVG preview renderer uses the same component and connection specification.

guide.validation: All 27 PNGs fully decode and are nonblank. Synthetic costs, tokens, exact-user filters, task cost bases and LMDI terms reconcile. Zero capture browser/console errors or unexpected requests. Final guide browser verification is recorded separately in the translation ledger.
